_doc: Ash's bicycle (bike/bike.gd) and the townspeople's (bike/cyclists.gd). Speeds m/s, accelerations m/s2, times s, angles radians. throttle_full: the stick tilt that already means full pedalling (a normal push, not right to the edge); cruise_speed: the stick pushed nearly out, on the flat; sprint_speed: the stick right out (standing on the pedals to get there); max_speed: the most a descent can take him to (gravity runs him past the flat top speeds; drag bleeds it off on the flat after); accel: pedalling's pull, full until within accel_taper m/s of the target, then down to accel_min x it (holding the pace the legs also make up the air drag and the climb); coast_decel + drag x v2: rolling with the pedals still; release_decel: letting go of the stick on the flat (an easy stop; it fades out on a downhill, where he freewheels and gravity builds the speed), below release_stop m/s brake_decel stops him crisply (also getting off, busy); brake_hard: the brake button; skid_speed: a hard stop above this skids. turn_r_min + turn_r_k x v2: the tightest turn at a speed (m; tighter than a real bicycle, on purpose: about 0.8 m at 3 m/s, 2.3 at 9), never faster than turn_rate_max (rad/s); turn_gain: how hard the stick turns toward where it points (rad/s per rad); turn_resp: how fast the turn takes hold (1/s). carve_decel: a very sharp turn at speed (the stick more than carve_angle rad off the heading, above carve_from m/s) stops the pedalling and scrubs up to this much speed (m/s2) so the turn stays tight. pivot_rate: walking the bike round, stopped (rad/s; no turning on the spot while rolling); pinned against a wall with the stick into it, he walks it round toward the nearest way out at the same rate. lean_gain: the lean into a turn (1 = a real bicycle's). slope_gain: how much gravity pulls him back uphill (pedalling, the pace is set by slope_slow); slope_down_gain: how much it runs him on downhill (1 = all of it; more: an arcade rush). surface_mult / surface_drag: by ground (path dirt and stone 1; water has its own below). hop_vy: the jump button's bunny hop; ledge_vy: riding off a ledge. No steepness lock: anywhere Ash can walk or wade, the bike rides (indoors excepted). step_max: a step higher than this between cells is stairs: he slows to stairs_speed before them (braking at brake_decel) and bumps over each one. Slopes: past slope_free (rise per metre) uphill slows him by slope_slow x the extra slope (at 0.3 about three quarters), never under slope_min_speed x the speed; downhill runs on up to max_speed. stamina (body.gd's bar, the same one as running; body.json run_drain 0.026 for comparison): drain_flat a second pedalling, drain_sprint sprinting, plus drain_climb x the slope past slope_free (counted up to climb_max: steep climbs cost more than running); regen_coast coasting or rolling downhill, regen_stop stopped (after body.json regen_delay); worn out (the fatigue condition): no sprint, fatigued_speed x the top speed, climbs slowed fatigued_climb x more, fatigued_hunch the hunch over the bars (panting). bump_back: the speed bounced back from a wall (times the speed). npc_brake: start braking this far (m) from someone in the way. cam_pull / cam_drop / cam_lag: the camera at top speed (further back, a little lower, following a little later); cam_fov: degrees the view widens by at full speed (from cam_fov_from m/s, eased; camera.json fov the base); speed_lines: [from, full] m/s the faint speed lines show by speed (also at full flow); cam_follow: how soon it swings in behind; cam_swing_max: the fastest it swings round (rad/s), so a tight turn never whips it. gear: chainring and cog teeth (the cadence follows the wheel). bell_gap: the soonest a bell rings again. parked: where the bike starts (beside Ash's house) [x, z, yaw]. npc: the townspeople who ride (riders: person -> bike look), their speeds (3.5..5 m/s), slow_speed with Ash in the way, the shortest leg worth riding (min_leg, m), how much of it must be path (road_share), how far (fetch, m) a bike may be to go and get it, where they get off before a stop (park_before, m), how far they ring the bell at Ash (bell_dist), and their bikes' detail (fewer segments round: 0.6). looks: bike looks over bike/looks.json (the same fields). flow: riding steady builds a speed-up (bike.gd _flow_step): gain = the most it adds (x the target speed: 0.18 = 18%), max_speed the cap at full flow, build = seconds from none to full (eased), yaw_ok the turn rate (rad/s) it still builds under, yaw_drain the turn rate it drains over (between: holds; a road's bends hold it, hard turns drain it; the assist's light braking for a bend keeps it), slope_max the climb (rise per metre) it builds under, surface_min the slowest ground (surface_mult) it builds on; drains a second: drain_turn (sharp turns, up to x2), drain_brake, drain_surface, drain_uphill, drain_ease (stick eased off); reset_speed: below this it is gone; tuck (rider lean forward), cam_pull (m), lines_from (speed lines from this flow up). assist: the road assist (bike/assist.gd, graph bike/paths.json): lookahead_min + lookahead_k x speed = the pursuit point ahead (m), never more than lookahead_narrow x the path's half width (narrow decks: it follows closely), gain the pursuit's steering, engage_ang (rad) heading and stick within this of the path to take over, override (rad) the stick this far off straight ahead (camera relative) steers by hand, nudge (rad): at a fork (lazy: it keeps rolling straight) a push more than this off straight ahead with at least fork_tilt of tilt, pointing within fork_align (rad) of a branch's way out, picks that branch (a slight drift never does), and near a fork the stick may go up to fork_override (rad) off straight ahead toward a branch without taking the steering back; the goal (setting) only picks where no branch runs on within straight_ang (rad) of straight; fork_la: the lookahead x this through a junction (a smooth line, no pull to the node), blend_in (s): the assist's steering eases in over this when it takes over (no yank onto a path); hand_from (rad): inside the override band the stick's own turn blends in from this far off straight ahead (all of it at override), so a turn on a path answers at once (not when the stick picked a branch ahead), edge_margin (m) past the path's half width it lets go, capture (m) past it it takes over again within 3 s of being steered off (it then brings him back on), lat_acc (m/s2) the sideways pull it allows in bends, brake (m/s2) its braking for them, signal_t (s) / signal_min (m) how early a fork is picked and shown, min_speed below this it does not steer, cruise_tilt the pedalling while cruising, double_tap (s) the gap for the double tap that starts cruise. Water (bike.gd, bike_water.gd): the bike goes wherever Ash could wade (body.json wade_fresh / wade_sea), and brakes to a stop before anything deeper. Depth = the water at the deeper tyre as the bike sits in it (m; the wade limit is about water_full = body.json vis_max). water_slow: [depth m, times the speed] points, linear between (ankle-deep a light drag, hub-deep about a third, near the limit a crawl); water_drag: more drag x speed squared at the full depth (x depth / water_full; m/s2 per (m/s)2); water_brake: the brakes this much stronger at the full depth; water_stamina: more stamina a second pedalling at the full depth (added to drain_flat / drain_sprint); water_stand: deeper than this he stands on the pedals; water_settle: faster than the water's pace (water_slow), it holds him back by this x the excess (1/s, x depth / water_full). water_margin: riding stops this much (m of depth) short of the wade limit, so turning round there never swings a tyre past it. A stream's bank or bed is ridden into, not taken as stairs. water_fx (bike_water.gd): drops / rings = the pool sizes; spray = drops a second off the front tyre at 6 m/s fully in (up to twice that faster) (the back tyre 0.6 of it), deep = the tyre depth (m) counted as fully in; rooster_from (m/s) the back tyre throws a rooster tail, rooster = its drops a second 6 m/s past that; burst = drops where a tyre hits the water (at 10 m/s); bow_h = the bow wave's ridge height (m, at 9 m/s, x (0.5 + depth)), bow_len = its length [slow, 14 m/s] (m); wake_len = the water's parted V [slow, 15 m/s] (m); foam_gap = m between foam patches behind, foam_life their seconds; ring_gap = s between wake rings; wet_splash = how far above the water spray wets the frame at speed (m); dry = m/s the wet line comes down out of the water; drip_time = s it drips after, drips = drops a second at first. trick (bike.gd, the 180): the stick flicked from within fwd_ang (rad) of ahead to within back_ang of straight behind in under flick_t s, both at least flick_tilt, not swept round the side, above min_speed m/s, on the ground, water under max_depth m: a hop of hop_vy (m/s) while the bike swings round over time s (eased), riding on the other way at keep x the speed; lean (rad) into it, tuck (rad) over the bars, dust = drops of dust where it lands; cooldown s before another. cam_time: the camera swings round with him over this (s, eased), behind the new heading by the landing; the stick still held where the flick left it (within latch_ang rad, at least latch_tilt) is read as straight on along the new heading until it is let go or moved away. wheelie (bike.gd; held: a pad's west face button (Y on a Nintendo pad), V, the touch button): the front wheel up to angle (rad) about the back axle, in pop s, down in drop s, a balance wobble of wobble rad at wobble_hz; no speed lost; steering x steer; lean_back (rad) sat back with straight arms; dropped below min_speed m/s, in water over max_depth m, on a landing harder than hard_land (squash) or against a wall, for lock s.
